title: Blitch has been inside several underground facilities
summary: John Blitch tells of Blitch has been inside several underground facilities, about unspecified at underground military facilities, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: fire but I've been in several of them

plain: John Blitch is a former military scientist who says he was once taken by an alien. On a podcast with host Jesse Michels he says he has been inside several underground military facilities, though he gives no dates or places. It matters to his story because it would mean he has seen hidden sites that few people ever get to see.
